Hobgoblin_Devastator
Devastator Lizabett is a hobgoblin member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins, underneath Baldur's Gate. He attacks the party if they attempt to cross the Manslaughter Chasm.

Involvement

As part of the 'test' to enter the Bhaal Temple, the  Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev surprises the party with a combat encounter. He begins casting a ritual spell to kill the entire active party after a certain number of turns, and his minions (including Lizabett) attack the party as they attempt to cross the bridge to stop Ghislev.
